name: Node.js
install_content:
apk add --no-cache curl nodejs npm 
mkdir -p /home/container 
cd /home/container 
npm install typescript ts-node @types
update_content:
npm install -g npm 
npm install typescript ts-node @types/node

runtime._note: start-up detects if a container has started or not via logs.
